svg.title: Distributed embedding extraction
svg.desc: Each Parquet shard in the input manifest is one task. Shards are split across nodes by estimated load, and inside a node the GPU worker processes pull the next shard whenever they finish one, so a slow shard no longer leaves the other workers idle at the end. Inside a worker, reading, decoding, GPU inference and writing overlap so the GPU stays busy, while only a few shards are in flight. Ready images from different shards that share a decode path are merged into one full batch, and each vector is written back to its own shard and row. Timings and row numbers are illustrative.

g.font-family: Arial, PingFang SC, Heiti SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif
g.text: (a) Shards to nodes to GPU workers
